product_from_film: Perplexity Model Council runs a question through three selected models and compares their answers.
explains_well: The film shows where to enable the mode, select models and inspect agreements, disagreements and individual responses.
unclear: The dense output tables pass too quickly to show why one disagreement matters or what the user should do next.
scenario: Compare three answers about US inflation in 2025
product_clear_basis: Model Council mode and three enabled model toggles are visible.

lessons.keep: Expose both the combined comparison and the original model responses.
try: For a Tin research comparison, highlight one disagreement row, then open its two source passages before returning to the summary.
Try a compact three-model progress view followed by one agreement, one disagreement and one unresolved question, with enough hold time to read.
lessons.avoid: Avoid implying that three agreeing models establish accuracy or showing more text than the viewer can inspect.
lessons.open: Economic output accuracy, source checks, model independence, performance and all audio remain unverified.
